title: Step 67-C Admin application foundation and secure transport
description: Create only the Admin frontend application foundation: an independent React Router SSR workspace, Persian RTL shell primitives, exact design-token bridge, typed server-only API transport, strict Admin cookie isolation and deterministic quality gates. Do not implement login/FIDO/session probing, permission-aware navigation, Step-Up UX, dashboard metrics, later Admin domain workspaces, Backend/OpenAPI changes, database changes or current-state closure.

dependencies.evidence: PR #353 merged; exact-SHA Canonical CI #1778, Phase A #1277, Storefront #815 and CodeQL #925 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 6143931051.

acceptance_criteria.description: apps/admin is an independent exact-pinned React Router Framework Mode SSR workspace using the existing free/open-source frontend stack and canonical Node/pnpm versions, with no new external dependency family.

Admin root renders Persian fa-IR RTL semantics, skip-link, one main landmark and shell primitives using the canonical generated token bridge and logical CSS; no brown palette or physical left/right layout properties are introduced.
Admin API request and response typing derives from src/generated/openapi.ts; server API configuration is server-only and no VITE_* credential or deployment authority is exposed.

Admin auth transport forwards only allow-listed Admin session/pre-auth cookies, strips Authorization and unrelated cookies, requires HttpOnly Path=/ SameSite=Strict host-only Set-Cookie semantics and never forwards customer session cookies.

Production routes do not yet call login, FIDO, session/me/permissions/scopes, Step-Up or dashboard endpoints; no permission-aware destination, domain mutation or dashboard metric is implemented before 67-D/67-E/67-G.
Root canonical pnpm verify executes Admin typecheck, ESLint, SSR build and deterministic Stage-C foundation/transport/browser checks in addition to the existing Storefront verification chain.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, CodeQL/security, deterministic Review and exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release. Human Gate is not required for MEDIUM-risk 67-C.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 67-C is MEDIUM risk. No Human Gate is required. 67-D remains blocked until 67-C terminal canonical closure.
